questions.question: The institution named for the 1924 membership has been corrected to the Russian Academy of Sciences. Verify the dates and nature of the memberships and the scope of the generalization about university seminars after 1910.

localizations.source: The institution named for the 1924 membership has been corrected to the Russian Academy of Sciences. Verify the dates and nature of the memberships and the scope of the generalization about university seminars after 1910.
localizations.ru: Историческое название академии в сведении о членстве 1924 года исправлено на Российскую академию наук. Остаётся проверить даты и характер академического членства и степень обобщения об университетских семинарах после 1910 года.

questions.question: Confirm the chronology of persecution, arrest and exile, the sentence and the account of his death in Kazan against archival sources.

questions.question: Establish a verifiable public source for Dmitri Egorov’s portrait, the artist or photographer (if known), the date, and the licence or verified public-domain status.

localizations.source: Establish a verifiable public source for Dmitri Egorov’s portrait, the artist or photographer (if known), the date, and the licence or verified public-domain status.
localizations.ru: Установить проверяемый публичный первоисточник портрета Д. Ф. Егорова, автора или фотографа (если известен), дату и лицензию либо подтверждённый статус общественного достояния.
